The following events took place in '''65 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

This year was known as '''Year 30''' before the [[Great ReSynchronization]].

==Events==
*The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] take control of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] becomes the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], and is dubbed ''[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious''.<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
*The [[Bitthævrian War]] begins. {{Circa}}<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
*The [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]] is constructed.<ref name="Plagueis" />

==Births==
*[[Maw (Dark Jedi)|Maw]] {{Circa}}<ref name="The Dark Forces Saga 4">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050526a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 4: Of the Crudest Matter}}</ref>
